description:
Use this when the user asks for the contents or a summary of one specific BSE filing of an Indian company, using a news_id from get_stock_events. It may queue processing and use a small daily allowance.

Returns the facts extracted from the filing's PDF, each with a verbatim quote, and a summary when those facts support one. `query` is the company's NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code; `news_id` comes from get_stock_events or get_announcement_bucket. If the filing has not been extracted yet, the call queues it, waits up to about 30 seconds, and otherwise returns `status: "pending"` with `retry_after_seconds`: call again after it. Queuing is its only write and uses a small daily allowance; reading an extracted one does not. Financial-results filings are not extracted: use get_financials. For several filings of one company use get_filing_extracts. Without an extraction, a `note` says why, plus any `attachment_url` to the PDF.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
